'''Plook Hartar''' was a crimelord during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A rival of [[Servid Norn]], both Hartar and Norn believed that they employed the best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Nominating a pilot from their crew to participate in a race across the galaxy, they agreed that the winner would be whoever reached the destination first. Beginning on [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], each pilot had to obtain a docking permit from the planets [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Almania]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], and [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Once the permits were acquired they had to be delivered to the spaceport controller in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Unbeknownst to Hartar, Norn had placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Scranton Toon]], Hartar's pilot, in an attempt to win.<ref name="Bounties" />
